walkthroughs.title: Sudden breathlessness and pain with breathing

doorway: I suddenly got short of breath this morning. It hurts on the right when I take a deep breath.
Vital signs are available on the chart.
Perform a focused history and physical examination, discuss your plan, and document only what you obtain.

plan.notice: Acute breathlessness with pleuritic discomfort requires attention to oxygenation and stability before routine questioning.
plan.pivot: Ask onset, hemoptysis, leg symptoms, immobility and relevant hormonal or medication exposures. Risk factors change probability; they do not confirm a clot.
plan.exam: Assess general respiratory status, bilateral air entry, heart and legs. Avoid treating a normal lung examination as exclusion of pulmonary embolism.
plan.avoid: Reassuring from age or normal breath sounds while ignoring tachycardia, hypoxemia or abrupt onset.

goals: Recognize the dyspnea–pleuritic pain–leg symptom relationship.
Ask about estrogen, immobilization and prior clots before anchoring on anxiety.
A clear lung examination does not exclude pulmonary embolism.
